title: cairn site record, contract 1
description: The record, cairn-site.json, at the root of a site. It holds the facts about a site that have no other home: its kind, its features, its theme options, the engine that scaffolded it, and the deploy values the setup tool writes once. cairn.config.ts imports it.

kind.description: The kind of site, from the closed list in definitions/kinds.json.

features.description: The features the site turns on, from the closed list in definitions/features.json.

themeOptions.description: The theme's option choices, keyed by the option keys in the theme's manifest.

aiPosture.description: Whether the site invites or declines AI use of its content. Absent until the owner chooses.

engine.description: The engine version the setup tool installed.

composer.description: The composer that assembled the site, when one did.

deploy.description: The values the setup tool writes once when it deploys the site.

publicOrigin.description: The site's public address, an https origin with no path.

emailFrom.description: The address sign-in emails come from.

github.description: The GitHub repository and App that commit the site's content.

owner.description: The GitHub account or organization that owns the repository.

branch.description: The branch the CMS commits to.

installationId.description: The id of the App's installation on the repository.
